in_hebrew.name: ריינוואלד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ריינוואלד מקורו במילים הגרמניות 'ריין' ו'וולד', שפירושם 'עץ יער מלכותי' או 'מלך העץ'. השם נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'רין' ו'וולד', שפירושם 'שופט' ו'לד', ומשמעו 'שופט צדיק' או 'מלך צדיק'.

in_greek.name: Ρέινβαλντ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ρέινβαλντ προέρχεται από τις γερμανικές λέξεις 'Rhein' και 'Wald', που σημαίνει 'δασικός βασιλιάς' ή 'ισχυρός κυβερνήτης'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, αλλά οι ρίζες του βρίσκονται στις ελληνικές λέξεις 'ῥήτωρ' και 'βάλς', που σημαίνουν 'ρητορικός' και 'βασιλιάς'.

in_latin.name: Reinwald
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Reinwald originem habet in vocibus germanicis 'Rhein' et 'Wald', quae significant 'silvae rex' vel 'dux potens'. In ecclesia primitiva christiana, nomen hoc non invenitur directe, sed radix eius in latina voce 'rex' invenitur, quae significat 'rex' vel 'princeps'.

in_english.name: Reinwald
in_english.long_meaning: The name Reinwald originates from Germanic words 'Rhein' and 'Wald', meaning 'ruler of the forest' or 'powerful king'. Derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, it signifies a strong and righteous leader. Historically, the name has been used in Christian traditions to denote a powerful and just ruler. The name Reinwald symbolizes strength, leadership, and wisdom.

data.cultural_impact: The name Reinwald may have originated from the Germanic cultures, whose society was heavily influenced by the concept of rulers or leaders in the community. The name reflects the significance and importance of leadership in shaping the lives of individuals and communities. It also suggests a sense of strength, power, and authority associated with leaders.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Reinwald can be seen as a reminder of the importance of good leadership in our lives, both in the world and in the spiritual realm. It can be seen as a call to aspire to become leaders who govern with wisdom, compassion, and justice. It can also be seen as a reminder of the ultimate Leader, God, who rules over all creation with love and wisdom. The name Reinwald can inspire us to strive for personal spiritual growth, to become rulers of our own lives, and to rule our passions and desires with the same wisdom and compassion that a true leader would.
